name: Agent Evidence API
tagline: Cited web evidence and claim verification for agents
description: A remote MCP server that fetches public web sources and returns structured, cited evidence for a question or claim: source URL, retrieval timestamp, short excerpt and content hash for every item, plus an explicit supported / contradicted / mixed / inconclusive assessment. Free `initialize` and `tools/list`; each `research_evidence` call is paid per call in USDC on Base over x402.

install.notes: Discovery is free (initialize, tools/list, ping, health). A research_evidence call answers HTTP 402 with the price and the x402 payment requirements; pay $0.003 USDC on Base per call. No account or API key.
